description: Calculate the d-band center of a pseudomorphic Pt monolayer overlayer on Cu(111).
user_prompt: Build a Cu(111) surface slab and deposit a pseudomorphic monolayer of Pt on top of it (a full Pt overlayer coherent with the Cu lattice). Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the Pt overlayer atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.
